# 任务树 fixture：多节点环（A→B→A）与三节点环（A→B→C→A）
# 本文件不含任何游戏素材。

zz_cycle_missions = {
	slot = 1

	# ① 两节点环：zz_cyc_a → zz_cyc_b → zz_cyc_a
	zz_cyc_a = {
		icon = mission_generic
		required_missions = { zz_cyc_b }
		trigger = { always = yes }
		effect = { add_prestige = 1 }
	}

	zz_cyc_b = {
		icon = mission_generic
		required_missions = { zz_cyc_a }
		trigger = { always = yes }
		effect = { add_prestige = 1 }
	}
}

zz_cycle3_missions = {
	slot = 2

	# ② 三节点环：x → y → z → x
	zz_cyc_x = {
		icon = mission_generic
		required_missions = { zz_cyc_y }
		trigger = { always = yes }
		effect = { add_prestige = 1 }
	}

	zz_cyc_y = {
		icon = mission_generic
		required_missions = { zz_cyc_z }
		trigger = { always = yes }
		effect = { add_prestige = 1 }
	}

	zz_cyc_z = {
		icon = mission_generic
		required_missions = { zz_cyc_x }
		trigger = { always = yes }
		effect = { add_prestige = 1 }
	}

	# ③ 正常链（不应报）：ok1 → ok2 → ok3，无环
	zz_ok_1 = {
		icon = mission_generic
		trigger = { always = yes }
		effect = { add_prestige = 1 }
	}

	zz_ok_2 = {
		icon = mission_generic
		required_missions = { zz_ok_1 }
		trigger = { always = yes }
		effect = { add_prestige = 1 }
	}

	zz_ok_3 = {
		icon = mission_generic
		required_missions = { zz_ok_2 }
		trigger = { always = yes }
		effect = { add_prestige = 1 }
	}

	# ④ 引用了外部（vanilla）任务 —— 不应被算进环
	zz_ext_ref = {
		icon = mission_generic
		required_missions = { conquer_scotland }
		trigger = { always = yes }
		effect = { add_prestige = 1 }
	}
}
